name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Self-contained Oasisfish coding agent for Windows

scripts.package: pnpm -w run build && pnpm run build && pnpm run icon:generate && pnpm run runtime:prepare && pnpm run harness:prepare && pnpm run stage:verify && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:publish: pnpm -w run build && pnpm run build && pnpm run icon:generate && pnpm run runtime:prepare && pnpm run harness:prepare && pnpm run stage:verify && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.package:dir: pnpm -w run build && pnpm run build && pnpm run icon:generate && pnpm run runtime:prepare && pnpm run harness:prepare && pnpm run stage:verify && electron-builder --dir --win --x64
